name: greybel-api-reference-web
description: The reference of the GreyScript API on a page, with its scripting guide: the greybel-api-reference-web crate, in a worker, gives the page every type's section ready to show and responds to its searches; the page shows them and requests an editor, if it has one, to open examples

scripts.build: vite build && tsc -p tsconfig.build.json && tsc -p tsconfig.editor.json
